xln.text: Orazca is the golden city that Huatli glimpses when her spark ignites, and Emperor Apatzec promises her the title of warrior-poet if she can locate it.

Its history is one of misuse and loss, as the Sun Empire built the city around the Immortal Sun until an emperor misused it and Azor made the Empire leave, and the River Heralds later overthrew Orazca's human rulers and reclaimed it.
Now the Sun Empire and River Heralds find the Legion of Dusk and the Brazen Coalition racing them for its secret, while Bolas sends Vraska to retrieve an item from it.
Jace and Vraska reach Azor in his sanctum in Orazca, and Tezzeret steals the Immortal Sun through a planar portal, after which the Sun Empire retakes the city and moves its capital back there.

rix.text: Orazca rises from the jungle, and Huatli and Angrath watch its golden spires climb above the canopy of the valley.
Kumena steps onto the Immortal Sun and raises the city from the ground, flooding it with rivers, until Vona throws him out of the tower window.
Legion explorers ransack its tombs and temples hunting for the Immortal Sun, and opening Orazca unleashes more horrors than just the Sun.
In the Sun chamber, Azor tells Jace and Vraska that the Immortal Sun is the lock of his prison, and Jace sentences him to be the caretaker of Useless Island, leaving the Sun behind.
